integrity: The proof supplies symbolic interlacing, boundary factorization, and a rationally verified discriminant certificate; standalone reproducibility tests are included.
scientific_limitations: The all-height root classification covers convex planar base times a positive segment. For quotients above the sharp threshold one explicit failing height is proved, not a complete height-phase diagram. Earlier priority is not independently certified.
title: The sharp all-height Steiner real-rootedness threshold for arbitrary planar-base right prisms
